metadata.question: Did the snow water equivelent at Donner Pass higher in February than April in 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Donner Pass, California (approximately -120.32°W, 39.31°N) - Time: February 2022 vs April 2022 - Collection: MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily (MOD10A1) or better yet, MODIS/006/MOD10A1 which has SWE. Actually, for Snow Water Equivalent, I should use NASA's MODIS snow products or better SNOTEL data, but GEE has limited SWE datasets. Let me check for available datasets. - Actually, the best option is "NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001" which has Snow Water Equivalent (SWE_inst), or we can use MODIS snow cover as a proxy. - Better option: Use "NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture" which has ssm and susm but not SWE directly. - Best available: MODIS/006/MOD10A1 has "NDSI_Snow_Cover" but not SWE directly. - Let me use a global snow dataset: "MODIS/006/MOD10A1" has snow cover but for SWE I need to look for "NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001" which has SWE_inst band. 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for snow data, but I should filter for quality flags if available. - Calculate mean SWE for February 2022 and April 2022. 3. Logic: - If Feb SWE > April SWE, answer A (Yes) - If Feb SWE <= April SWE, answer B (No) - Handle cases where data is missing (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation fails (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const donnerPass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.31]); const region = donnerPass.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const feb2022Start = '2022-02-01'; const feb2022End = '2022-03-01'; const apr2022Start = '2022-04-01'; const apr2022End = '2022-05-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try FLDAS for SWE let febCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001') .filterBounds(donnerPass) .filterDate(feb2022Start, feb2022End) .select('SWE_inst'); let aprCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001') .filterBounds(donnerPass) .filterDate(apr2022Start, apr2022End) .select('SWE_inst'); const febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); const aprSize = aprCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2022 Images: ${febSize}`); console.log(`April 2022 Images: ${aprSize}`); if (febSize === 0 || aprSize === 0) { console.log('Trying alternative: MODIS daily snow cover product'); febCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(donnerPass) .filterDate(feb2022Start, feb2022End) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); aprCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(donnerPass) .filterDate(apr2022Start, apr2022End) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const febSizeMODIS = febCollection.size().getInfo(); const aprSizeMODIS = aprCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Feb 2022: ${febSizeMODIS}, Apr 2022: ${aprSizeMODIS}`); if (febSizeMODIS === 0 || aprSizeMODIS === 0) { console.log('No data available for comparison period'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean SWE const febMean = febCollection.mean(); const aprMean = aprCollection.mean(); // Check pixel counts const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const aprStats = aprMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const febVal = febStats.SWE_inst_mean || febStats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const febCount = febStats.SWE_inst_count || febStats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; const aprVal = aprStats.SWE_inst_mean || aprStats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const aprCount = aprStats.SWE_inst_count || aprStats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; console.log(`Feb 2022 - Mean: ${febVal}, Pixels: ${febCount}`); console.log(`Apr 2022 - Mean: ${aprVal}, Pixels: ${aprCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (febCount === 0 || aprCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (febVal === null || febVal === undefined || aprVal === null || aprVal === undefined) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(febVal) || isNaN(aprVal)) { console.log('Calculation returned NaN'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare values if (febVal > aprVal) { console.log('February SWE was higher than April'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('February SWE was not higher than April'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
